kinds.d: An in-ground grave space for a coffin or casket, of single, companion or family capacity.
A small in-ground plot for the burial of cremated remains in an urn.

kinds.a: natural burial plot · woodland burial plot
kinds.d: A grave space in a natural woodland or meadow setting, sometimes one of several sites around a shared tree.
A pre-built underground vault set in a lawn section of a cemetery.
An above-ground chamber for a casket inside a shared community mausoleum.
A freestanding building holding crypts for one family.
A compartment in a wall, stele or building for one or more urns.
A shared burial space where the remains of many people are placed together, with no separate site for each.

notes: All eight planned kinds kept one-to-one with old k60–k67; no merges or drops. Emptied all model lists (no brands or products exist for burial rights) and moved the former pseudo-models into attribute types: 'Gated estate' and 'Hedge estate' → types of Ground burial plot (with single/companion/family capacity, already implied by the old definition); 'Baumgrab' and 'Full Burial Shared Tree Plot' (renamed 'Shared-tree plot') → types of Green burial plot; 'Urnenstele' → type of Columbarium niche. Added plain aliases for findability; kept each kind's old source URL. No archetypes, new kinds or brand entries added, per the restraint-only brief.
